roles.root: read completed parent predictions, then selected repairs after checkpoint; synthesis is post-prediction researcher comparison
roles.authority_audit: normal qualification preceded predictions; subsequent repair scope review received a root boundary hint after root read model output, and is therefore researcher-guided boundary review, not fully model-blind oracle
roles.n2_selector: parent input/output and checker audit; explicitly excludes repairs and oracle
roles.repair_oracle: fresh no-history role; fixed source and repair evidence only; saves independent oracle before model-output access

deviation: Root sent a candidate-related boundary hint to authority_audit during repair review; this limits its blinding claim. The message is retained. A separate no-history reviewer was assigned without that hint.
